rationale: C20 plausibly supplied a material administrative template: it convenes representatives from multiple agencies into a temporary cooperative body, assigns a lead or chair, specifies the study's purpose and scope, calls for participation by non-Federal stakeholders, and anticipates a coordinated report. The child adapts that machinery to administrative procedure, with the Attorney General identifying participating agencies, each agency designating a delegate, named judicial and private members participating, a designated chair and secretary, organizational authority, and periodic reports. C11 and C08 contain related representative-body machinery, but their standing boards and formal assigned functions are less close to the child's conference model.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am happy to call a conference of representatives of the departments and agencies, and of the judiciary and the bar, for the purpose of studying the problems thus described.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am requesting that the various Federal agencies concerned... organize a temporary interagency committee for the purpose of initiating a comprehensive survey... and preparing recommendations
shared_material.explanation: Both create a temporary, multi-participant body to study a defined administrative problem and develop recommendations.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I request each department and agency receiving this call... to designate a representative to meet with other such representatives as delegates in a conference
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the Departments of the Interior, the Army, Agriculture and Commerce, and... agencies which will participate as members of the committee... Governors... [are] to designate official representatives
shared_material.explanation: Both use designated representatives from participating governmental bodies as the membership mechanism.

shared_material.child_excerpt: have requested Judge Prettyman to act as Chairman... [and] a representative of [Justice] to act as Secretary
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am designating the Department of the Army as the Chairman agency.
shared_material.explanation: Both expressly assign leadership for the newly convened cooperative body.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the conference will organize and fix its program and procedure... I shall be happy to receive from time to time reports from the conference as to its work.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: As its first order of business the committee... should prepare a detailed program... The final product... should be a single comprehensive report
shared_material.explanation: Both direct the body to organize its work through a program and report its results, although the child's reporting arrangement is less prescriptive.
